retrieval_results.excerpt: Requirements: Three to five or more years of experience in AI, machine learning, or computer vision; Python; OpenCV; TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks; computer-vision model deployment; object detection; image classification; video analytics; large datasets; and analytical problem-solving.

Requirements: A degree in artificial intelligence, data science, computer science, information technology, or a related science or engineering discipline; up to two years of professional experience; knowledge of machine-learning fundamentals, statistics, data analysis, agentic AI, LLMs, RAG, and domain-specific fine-tuning; Python with NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch; data visualisation; experience with structured or unstructured data; and software-development practice.

Minimum qualifications: A bachelor's degree or recent completion in computer science or a related engineering field; knowledge of at least one of machine learning, pattern recognition, NLP, data mining, or computer vision; a firm understanding of data structures and algorithms; and strong communication and teamwork skills.
